component.name: EC Controller
component.summary: Control MSI laptop hardware through the msi-ec driver

description.p: EC Controller is a graphical control panel and background service for MSI laptops on Linux, built on top of the msi-ec kernel driver.
It dynamically detects the features supported by your laptop model and provides controls for:

ul.li: Real-time CPU and GPU temperatures and fan RPM monitoring
Fan modes including Auto, Silent, Basic, and Advanced with a custom fan curve editor
Performance profiles including Comfort, Turbo, Eco, and Sport
Battery charge thresholds at 100%, 80%, 60%, or custom limits
Hardware switches for Cooler Boost, Fn and Windows key swap, webcam lock, and USB PowerShare
